title: A line break the author writes decides whether a list, a call chain or an operator chain is one line or one part per line, and `nvs fmt` lays out the rest
scope:
which line breaks `nvs fmt` reads as the author's choice, the one-line and one-part-per-line layouts of a list, a
`->` call chain and an `&&`, `||`, `??` or `.` chain, a broken control-structure condition, where an enum's brace goes, and the two
editor actions that add or remove those breaks. Not `match` arms or the `use` block, whose layouts their own rules keep;
not an html template body, a heredoc body or a template region, which `nvs fmt` never touches.
validatedBy: `crates/nvs-fmt/tests/list_layout.rs`, `crates/nvs-fmt/tests/chain_layout.rs` and the split and join cases under `tests/lsp/actions/`, as side goal `fmt-layout-from-breaks` lands them.
